scope: This 263-trade backtest applies six defined intraday credit-spread setups and their management rules. It does not include separate divergence strategies or reproduce the full current live configuration.
input_policy: Unavailable required inputs are not estimated or synthesized.
execution_basis: Modeled trades sell at the quoted bid and buy at the quoted ask at entry and exit, rather than assuming midpoint fills.
cost_note: Commissions and exchange fees are not included. No separate slippage model is documented.
